question: Simplify:[(24 times 6)timesleft{ {2÷ 2} times (18 - (12)/(2)) right}]
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify: [(24 × 6) × { {2 ÷ 2} × (18 - (12 ÷ 2)) }]

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

**Calculation:**

[(24 × 6) × { {2 ÷ 2} × (18 - (12 ÷ 2)) }]

⇒ [(24 × 6) × { {1} × (18 - 6) }]

⇒ [(24 × 6) × {1 × 12}]

⇒ [(24 × 6) × 12]

⇒ 144 × 12

⇒ 1728

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
